title: TikTok Makes a Key Move in AI, New Primary Department Emerges
excerpt: Recently, ByteDance has once again made organizational adjustments in the field of artificial intelligence, officially establishing a new AI first-level departm
content_html:
Recently, ByteDance has once again made organizational adjustments in the field of artificial intelligence, officially establishing a new AI first-level department, mainly focusing on the construction of data and security for large models. The department is led by Wang Yinglei (Adam Wang) and operates in parallel with core departments such as Seed, Flow, and Douyin. This is another important move in ByteDance's AI strategy, following the layout of Seed and Flow at the end of 2023.

It is understood that this newly established department did not emerge out of nowhere. One of its predecessors was the Global Data team, established in 2023. The team originally had around 100 members and primarily provided underlying data support for international business segments such as Dola and TikTok. As the large model business deepened, it gradually took on the responsibility of data procurement and quality management for Seed model training.

After internal integration, the upgraded team's business scope will comprehensively cover foundational models and application businesses, committed to providing high-quality cross-modal data services for all models under ByteDance. Specific work includes standard setting, data procurement, synthesis and cleaning, as well as quality assessment, providing a solid data foundation for the efficient and stable operation of large models.

content_html_zh:
近日，字节跳动在人工智能领域再次进行组织调整，正式成立新的AI一级部门，主要专注于大模型的数据和安全建设。 该部门由王英蕾（Adam Wang）领导，与Seed、Flow、抖音等核心部门并行运作。 这是继2023年底布局Seed、Flow之后，字节跳动AI战略的又一重要举措。

据了解，这个新成立的部门并不是凭空出现的。 其前身之一是 2023 年成立的全球数据团队。 该团队原本有100人左右，主要为Dola、TikTok等国际业务板块提供底层数据支持。 随着大模型业务的深入，逐渐承担起种子模型训练的数据采购和质量管理的责任。

内部整合后，升级后的团队业务范围将全面覆盖基础模型和应用业务，致力于为字节跳动旗下各模型提供高质量的跨模态数据服务。 具体工作包括标准制定、数据采购、合成清洗、质量评估等，为大模型高效稳定运行提供坚实的数据基础。
